description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying {0} due to Aluren, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Mischievous Pup.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mischievous Pup from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mischievous Pup by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Mischievous Pup enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Phantasmal Image from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
